title: Crunchy Mexican Tomato Bites
description: A simple, flavorful Mexican dish made with fresh tomatoes, crispy crust, and a hint of sourness. Perfect as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: 2. Roll out the flaky pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
3. Cut out small squares of dough, about 3 inches per side.
4. Place a small spoonful of diced tomatoes in the center of each square.
5. Fold the dough over the tomatoes to form a triangle and press the edges to seal.
6. Brush the tops with a little water and sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
7. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
8. Serve warm with a dollop of sour cream and crumble cheese, if desired.
